name: wptui
tagline: Keyboard-driven WhatsApp client as a terminal TUI
description: wptui is a keyboard-driven WhatsApp client rendered as a terminal TUI. It combines the Rust Ratatui terminal framework with the Go whatsmeow library, so messaging lives entirely in the terminal with fluid keyboard navigation. For users who want to keep WhatsApp out of heavyweight desktop apps, it offers a fast, scriptable, and distraction-free interface. It is an early, small project that points toward a rich terminal-native messaging experience.
highlights: Full WhatsApp client rendered as a terminal TUI
Keyboard-driven navigation for a distraction-free chat experience
curatorNote: Messaging usually lives in heavyweight desktop apps; wptui moves WhatsApp into a fast, keyboard-driven terminal TUI. A neat Ratatui-and-whatsmeow combination for terminal loyalists.
